YOUR YEAR, IN PULL REQUESTS

Open Source Wrapped 2026.

Type a GitHub username and get a card of the year: merged pull requests, the projects they went to, reviews, and the busiest month. Made for sharing.

Public GitHub data only, read by your browser straight from GitHub. Nothing is stored or sent to CONTRI.

Share on XShare on LinkedIn

What it counts: pull requests you opened that were merged in 2026, pull requests and issues you opened, and other people's pull requests you reviewed, all from GitHub's public search. Projects and the busiest month come from your first 100 merged pull requests of the year. Private work is not visible, so this is a floor, not the whole story. GitHub allows about ten of these lookups a minute per network.

See this on every issue. CONTRI puts the same check under each issue title on GitHub, and next to every title on a project's issue list. Free and open source.
